title: Kaiser's brass band work and clarinetists with Kid Ory's band
summary: Kaiser played brass bands and orchestras; Barnes recalls who was in Ory's band, and says men swapped clarinetists freely.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Kaiser, Kaiser I would just play in the place but he played brass bands. He played brass bands too? Oh brass bands, yeah.

Who? What brass bands? Oh the different brass bands. I wouldn't know. I don't know. I don't know. I can't keep up with them now because it's been so long. But he played brass bands and orchestra and he played in town.
Well what about Kid Orri's band? Who played clarinet with him?
Kid Orri's band. Who did he have on trumpet? On trumpet, he had Joao.
He'd have T.O. and Oliver and Ory. That's right. I always thought Johnny Dodge played with that band.

Johnny Dodge could have played with him on a certain reason. You see, those men would have fallen out of each other. You see? And they'd get anybody in their place like men like that. That's the way you speak to me. If I leave Chris, I'd go with anybody. Go to him, superior, superior, anybody.
